q: Which entrance has the highest step?
Doors should be at least 80 cm wide. Which are too narrow?
Library (75 cm) and science block (70 cm).
Which ramp is too steep if the guideline is 1 : 12? Explain.
The sports hall (1 : 8): it rises 1 cm for every 8 cm, steeper than 1 : 12.
Recommend which two entrances to fix first and justify.
Library and science block: both have high steps with no ramp and narrow doors, so they fully block wheelchair users from learning spaces.
